verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a web tax portal and mobile app like ELSTER and MeinELSTER+, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics, tracking, cookies, or any opt-out control. The cited items cover tax filing, certificates, receipt uploads and server status only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
